blocks.text: Maple Ridge Duplexes: streets and boundaries

items.t: A Maple Ridge duplex lot is dealt with under the City's provincial-housing pages, which treat single-family and duplex lots as one eligible class across the city.
The City sorts duplex potential by position, not by neighbourhood name: inside or outside the Urban Containment Boundary, and within or beyond 400 metres of a prescribed bus stop.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Duplexes: the housing stock

items.t: The duplex here is one option inside a wider small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) menu: the City lists secondary suites, detached garden suites, duplexes, triplexes and fourplexes as the forms an eligible lot can take.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Duplexes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The unit count is mechanical: under 281 square metres of lot area allows up to three dwelling units; 281 to 4,050 square metres allows up to four; and the same size range within 400 metres of a prescribed bus stop allows up to six.
A building permit is required for SSMUH work, and construction must comply with the BC Building Code and the City's Building Bylaw; most developments under the new rules do not require a rezoning.
If the proposal is a multi-unit development — triplex, fourplex, courtyard or townhouse form — an approved development permit is required before a building permit application.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Duplexes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The City publishes an Urban Infill Residential checklist that works a lot through its own yes/no questions before a buyer pays for drawings.
The 400-metre frequent-transit test is the single fact that moves a mid-size lot from four units to six, so measure it to the prescribed bus stop, not to the nearest stop of any kind.
Planning for Growth is the City's live process: an open house on June 4, 2026 at the Maple Ridge Library covered the Transit-Oriented Area and SSMUH updates that duplex lots fall under.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Duplexes: costs and taxes

items.t: The 2026 flat water fee on the same City summary is $859.25, with an additional-unit flat fee of $429.60 — the line a duplex owner with a suite should check.
Transit proximity is a zoning fact in Maple Ridge, not just a convenience: lots within 400 metres of a prescribed bus stop can qualify for six units instead of four.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Duplexes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Lots outside Maple Ridge's Urban Area are treated separately in the City's SSMUH material, with a complete list held by the Planning Department, so a rural duplex lot needs a direct City confirmation.
